items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: Gene Michael, Paul Wilson and myself were -- went in that band together.

ctx.x: She's Argentinian. I left Perez Prado, there. We played Santiago, Chile, he also had Michael -- Gene Michael in the band. Saxophone player. Gene Michael was a famous first lead man, with Cecil's band. He was in that band. Gene Michael, Paul Wilson and myself were -- went in that band together. And then we came back to -- because

we weren't getting paid. Perez Prado, he didn't pay us off and he had a lot of money problems with the band and so we broke up and -- inSantiago, Chile. And came back to New York. Now that was the end of Perez Prado as far as we were concerned. Course he continued on with his band and I did a lot of work -- that's when I started work -- doing subs for Wilbur's band. Gigging around at other little places I could get.
